description: What QualiLoop knows about the agent under test: its general description, the capabilities it has confirmed (what the agent can do for a user), the coverage of tests over them (how much of the agent the tests reach), each capability marked covered or not with the names of the uncovered ones, and whether an exploration is running. Use it to find what is not tested yet before writing tests.
